credit_metrics.text: EBITDA was broadly unchanged at {{ebitda@FY2024}}, a move of {{ebitda.change@FY2024}}, while operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} after a payment to Virgin in a contract renegotiation and a restructuring provision at Orly.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity to revenue declined by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

The group launched a cash tender offer on two existing bond tranches and announced its intention to issue new bonds to refinance part of its existing debt.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}} in FY2024.

The fleet grew by {{fleet.change@FY2024}} to {{fleet@FY2024}} aircraft, with the average age broadly unchanged at {{fleet_age@FY2024}}, although fleet renewal was delayed by supply chain constraints and engine problems on part of the new-generation fleet.
The group completed the acquisition of a minority stake in SAS and began a deepened commercial cooperation with the airline.
